findings.claim: get_monitor_environment_context() in incident_occurrence.py copies the monitor config and replaces schedule_type with its human-readable display value, but returns monitor_environment.monitor.config (the original, line 168) instead of the modified copy. The schedule_type transformation therefore never reaches the event context.

verifier.reason: In src/sentry/monitors/logic/incident_occurrence.py:160-162, get_monitor_environment_context() copies monitor_environment.monitor.config and overwrites config["schedule_type"] with get_schedule_type_display(), but line 168 returns monitor_environment.monitor.config instead of the modified config copy. However, this bug already existed verbatim in src/sentry/monitors/logic/mark_failed.py before the patch merely relocated the function.
